Ch 17 (or another odd # of your choosing), hold your place, ch5 more, dc into the 17th chain that you’re holding (or whatever odd # you chose), ch1, skip a chain and dc into the 2nd stitch, ch1, skip a chain and dc into the second stitch. Continue till the end. Ch1 and turn, dc into the first stitch. Ch1, skip the space & dc into the next stitch. Ch1, skip the space & dc into the next stitch. Continue till the end. Repeat this row until desired length.   #crochetscarf #crochetheadband #crochettutorial #crochet #freecrochetpattern

Alexandria Masse is a Canadian textile artist making a powerful statement about reproductive rights. She’s creating the Birth Control Tapestry, a massive project where she crochets her birth control info sheet word for word. Each stitch is done during her menstruation week, making the work deeply personal and tied to her own body. Since starting in 2025, she has poured months of dedication into this piece, using kilometers of yarn to build a tapestry already larger than herself. The artwork sparks conversations about bodily autonomy, women’s rights, and healthcare access, turning knowledge into a tangible, immersive experience. Alexandria hopes to display the finished tapestry in a museum or gallery, so visitors can see the full scale and feel the history and struggles woven into every stitch. Her project blends artistry, activism, and education, showing how creativity can make a real difference. Follow her journey on Instagram 👉 @alexandria.masse, where she shares updates and reflections on her process. #AlexandriaMasse​ #BirthControlTapestry​ #TextileArt​ #ReproductiveRights​ #WomensRights​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​
